findings.title: Attacks 1 and 10, sibling of P4-RT-06-02: no run without JavaScript reads T12's orbit drawing or matrix cells on M8, so twelve blank T12 figures pass nojs.spec.ts and M8.spec.ts
findings.location: site/tests/e2e/nojs.spec.ts:65-151 (toolReport, figureProblems); site/tests/e2e/M8.spec.ts:251-268 ('M8 renders without JavaScript'); T12RepresentationBuilder.svelte (the string viewer's Board is the last panel, the orbit drawing data-out="orbit-graph" and the MatrixViews come first)
findings.claim: nojs.spec.ts's figure predicate accepts every T12 root as 'board' through the string viewer's board and never reads the orbit drawing or the matrices. M8.spec.ts checks only that data-out="matrix-e" exists and reads the orbit table's caption, never a vertex of the orbit or a cell of a matrix. So a server render that dropped the orbit drawing and every matrix entry of every M8 instance would pass the whole run without JavaScript (T12.spec.ts counts orbit vertices on /tools/rep/ only).
findings.expected: SPEC 7.4: 'A Playwright run with JavaScript disabled checks, for every lesson, that the text, every default figure and every table are present'. SPEC 4 T12 lists the figure as 'the orbit drawn in layers with edges coloured by node; the matrices E_k, F_k, H_k shown as grids'. With every vertex and edge of each M8 orbit drawing and every MatrixView cell removed, the no-JavaScript checks reject the roots.
findings.observed: With JavaScript off on /modules/m8-lie-algebras/, the reproducer removes every [data-vertex], every [data-edge] and every [data-row][data-col] cell; before removal every root had an orbit and matrices. nojs.spec.ts's toolReport, copied unchanged, then accepts all 12 roots: 'b1 as board' ... 'b12 as board'. M8.spec.ts's per-instance checks (matrix-e count 1, the orbit table caption, dimension) still pass.

findings.specRef: SPEC.md 7.4 'Without JavaScript' (the Playwright run checks every default figure of every lesson); SPEC 4 T12 (the orbit drawn in layers, the matrices as grids or lists); RED-TEAM-COMMON 2 ('a specific way in which a test ... proves less than it says'); P4-RT-06-02 (the same gap, fixed for T10 only)
findings.proposedFix: In M8.spec.ts's no-JavaScript test, or in toolReport for T12 roots, require the visible orbit drawing (data-out="orbit-graph") to hold the instance's dimension of [data-vertex] elements when drawn (the layer counts above 300), and each MatrixView to hold data-rows by data-cols cells (grid) or its listed nonzero entries (list).

notes: Attack 18's failure condition 'any worker request' is met on 103 of 163 T12 links, every one a chevalleySerre post. This follows the coordinator's ruling recorded in DECISIONS.md ('2026-10-24 P5-A2: where each call runs, and the relation list', the MERGE entry 'Accepted deviations', and RELATIONS_MAIN_WORK = 2500). To do this, T12 passes relationsHint, an 'enumeration' hint without expectedItems, so that whereToRun sends a call of known size to the worker. That contradicts worker.ts's header ('everything runs on the main thread except the three cases of E-9'). No default state is affected (the digest stands for it), so this is not reported as a finding. The owner may want E-9 or CONTRACTS 4 to say so, as P5-A2's request for an explicit hint field to P1-A2 asks.

T12's default start is omega_i, (1, 0) on A2. decisions/P5-A2.md says 'the specification left open ... the start', but SPEC 6.6 gives `start` a default ('all ones for numbers'). Recorded for the owner. defaultState('rep') carries no start, so attack 27's comparison has nothing to fail.

Download data on a configured T12 state whose relation list is above RELATIONS_MAIN_WORK (M8 b6 E6 node 1, b7 E7 node 7) writes `relations: null`. Only the shown relation's sides come from the digest, while the same state opened by link gets the full list from the worker. The comment in T12RepresentationBuilder.svelte's activate says the list is computed 'when the reader asks ... for the data', but exportData only computes it within the bound. SPEC 6.6 Data export asks for 'the derived tables shown on screen', and the full list is not shown, so this is not reported. It belongs to the export lens.

Stale wording: the MDX header comment of m8-lie-algebras.mdx, the DECISIONS entry '2026-10-24 P5-A3' and a comment in M8.spec.ts ('the 56 of E7, computes its relations on the main thread') still say that T12 computes a configured state's relation list on the main thread. Since the P5-A2 repair, the server ships it as a digest and hydration computes no list.

The data table of A-10 (T12's orbit and board tables) is present in the server HTML but inside the closed 'Show as table' <details>, as on every tool (note for the owner). T12's matrices are visible tables.

In the first sweep at load average about 20, the 1280x800 stepwise scroll left some client:visible islands unhydrated on M0 to M4 (up to 5 on M0). Two re-probes at load 10 to 14 left none, and the hydrateEveryIsland run at 1280 left none on all 9 lessons. This was recorded as a load artefact, not a finding.
